algorithm.title: Evaluation and Management of Osteochondritis Dissecans of the Knee.

cell.label: Suspected OCD of knee. Obtain posteroanterior, lateral, and tunnel-view radiographs.
Obtain radiographs of contralateral knee and MRI to determine stage of lesion.
cell.path: Stage I or stage II (low-signal rim)

cell.label: Conservative measures: Stop competitive sports for 6 to 8 weeks. Low-intensity physical rehabilitation Goal: symptom-free activities of daily living.
Discharge patient to self-monitoring of symptoms.
Failure to improve, symptoms worsen or crepitus develops.
Orthopedic referral for arthroscopy to evaluate overlying cartilage.
Orthopedic referral for arthroscopy or open removal.
Search for other cause of knee pain.

footnotes.footnote: From Hixon AL, Gibbs LM. Osteochondritis dissecans: a diagnosis not to miss. Am Fam Physician 2000;61:151–158.
